spells.name: fireball
spells.behavior: Aim at the hero's position on release. Move the fireball in a straight line; remove it on collision or when it leaves the map. Move the boss one step backward during the hop.

spells.name: lightning
spells.sequence: cast-01 -> cast-02 -> cast-03 -> inner 3 -> middle 6 -> outer 9
spells.behavior: Show each ring separately in order from near to far.

spells.name: shield
spells.sequence: cast-01 -> cast-02 -> cast-03 -> shield and approach for 3 seconds -> explosion
spells.behavior: Boss is invulnerable for the full 3-second countdown and walks toward the hero. At zero, remove the shield and trigger the explosion.
